name: Vonage
label: Vonage — Vonage Messages API
description: Vonage via the official Vonage Messages API. Base https://api.nexmo.com/v1. Docs: https://developer.vonage.com/en/api/messages. Official operations are POST /v1/messages (send) and PATCH /v1/messages/{message_uuid} (update status). get-message GET was removed — it is not in the Messages API. Local telecom rules apply. JWT application auth is an alternative the engine does not mint — supply Basic api_key:api_secret. listen = inbound webhooks as BPMN message events. Handler: OfficialApiNode (api_spec.json). OUTPUT is {status,http_status,data} or {error}. Inbound provider events are BPMN message events (operation listen), not a Webhook node.
author: 5c8b0d45-1d10-4f2e-844c-2318af96b2fa

ports.name: input
ports.description: One Vonage operation. Set operation plus the fields that operation needs. Do not put secrets on this port. Example: {"operation":"send-sms"}.

schema.label: operation
schema.description: Which official call to run. EXACT values: send-sms | listen. get-message GET was removed (not in the Messages API). listen / send-and-wait are kind:ingress — the handler does not open a socket; use a BPMN message start/catch/boundary event. Example: first verb.

schema.label: to
schema.description: Recipient phone number in E.164 format, required by send-sms (leading + optional). Example: 15551234567.

schema.label: from
schema.description: Sender ID for send-sms (required): a Vonage virtual number or an alphanumeric sender ID where the country allows it. Example: 15557654321.

schema.label: text
schema.description: SMS text for send-sms (required; sent with fixed channel sms and message_type text). Example: Hello.

ports.name: output
ports.description: Result object. Success: {status:'ok', http_status, data}. Ingress operations return a message telling the operator to use a BPMN message event. Secrets never appear. Errors raise a BPMN error for the error boundary event (INVALID_INPUT, AUTH_FAILED, RATE_LIMITED, HTTP_<status>, REQUEST_FAILED); secrets are redacted.

schema.label: status
schema.description: Present on HTTP success. EXACT: ok.

schema.label: data
schema.description: Parsed JSON body from the provider, or raw text if not JSON. Never contains secrets.

configurationParameters.label: Operation
configurationParameters.description: Default operation when INPUT omits operation. EXACT: send-sms, listen. get-message GET was removed (not in the Messages API). listen/send-and-wait instruct the operator to use BPMN message events.

configurationParameters.label: API secret
configurationParameters.description: Vonage API secret. HTTP Basic with api_key. StudioQuack secret. Never log. Never put on INPUT.

configurationParameters.label: API key
configurationParameters.description: Vonage API key used as HTTP Basic username, paired with api_secret. StudioQuack secret. Never log. Never put on INPUT.

configurationParameters.label: Timeout (seconds)
configurationParameters.description: Connect+read timeout for each official HTTPS call. Positive integer. Default 25. 0/blank → 25.

configurationParameters.label: Webhook Key
configurationParameters.description: Engine Webhook API Key binding ($webhookKeyRef) routing inbound HTTP webhooks to this node.
